meta.name: security
meta.description: How to handle `GRIDA-SEC-<id>` security boundaries in the Grida repo. Triggers when you encounter a `GRIDA-SEC` tag in source/docs, when modifying files under any tagged path, or when adding a new prevented- vulnerability record. Each `GRIDA-SEC-<id>` identifies a structural trust boundary documented in `/SECURITY.md`. This skill explains the contract, mandates a security review before committing changes to any tagged file, and shows how to register a new id. Use whenever "GRIDA-SEC" appears in context.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Grida 仓库中遇到 GRIDA-SEC 标记并需要遵守安全边界。
copy.tagline_en: Follow GRIDA-SEC security boundaries to avoid introducing vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter GRIDA-SEC tags in the Grida repo and need to comply with security boundaries.

howto.what: 安装后，当你在 Grida 仓库中遇到 `GRIDA-SEC-<id>` 标签时，Claude 会引导你阅读 `/SECURITY.md` 中的对应条目，执行安全审查，并确保修改不破坏安全边界。
howto.when: 当你在源代码或文档中看到 `GRIDA-SEC` 标签、修改标签路径下的文件，或添加新的预防漏洞记录时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个文件中的 GRIDA-SEC-001 边界是否被破坏。
say.note: Claude 会读取 SECURITY.md 并审查代码。

say.text: 我要添加一个新的 GRIDA-SEC 条目，编号是多少？
say.note: Claude 会查找最高编号并建议下一个。

say.text: 这个修改涉及 GRIDA-SEC-002，请执行安全审查。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤验证边界是否仍然有效。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you encounter a `GRIDA-SEC-<id>` tag in the Grida repo, Claude will guide you to read the corresponding entry in `/SECURITY.md`, perform a security review, and ensure changes do not break the security boundary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you see a `GRIDA-SEC` tag in source/docs, modify files under any tagged path, or add a new prevented-vulnerability record.

say_en.text: Check if the GRIDA-SEC-001 boundary is broken in this file.
say_en.note: Claude reads SECURITY.md and reviews the code.

say_en.text: I want to add a new GRIDA-SEC entry, what is the next ID?
say_en.note: Claude finds the highest existing ID and suggests the next.

say_en.text: This change touches GRIDA-SEC-002, please run the security review.
say_en.note: Claude verifies the boundary step by step.
